verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes a documented multi-API reference covering Cloud Agents, Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking and Origin. It also serves downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.3 specs with "detailed schemas and examples", markdown and llms.txt versions of every page, webhook verification snippets, and a Cookbook of end-to-end SDK examples. Nothing in the evidence shows an interactive reference where examples can be run in the browser. Missing for 10: an interactive in-docs API explorer or "try it" console, runnable examples executed from the reference itself, and hands-on corroboration of the docs experience.
